Sana (partnerships): Heads-up: SigmaSI requested a joint integration playbook for their SI teams to deploy our private package on customer infra. They want a clear matrix: onboarding steps, expected infra, KMS requirements, and cutover checklist.
Eli (eng-platform): We have a runbook for Private installs but need a trimmed version for SIs. Recommend a 4-step checklist: prep infra, install agent, configure KMS, run validation suite.
Marta (solutions): Add a customer checklist: network ports, outbound telemetry endpoints, and RBAC roles. Also include a small troubleshooting section (common errors + fixes).
Pri (sales): Useful to have a co-branded quickstart one-pager for SI reps. Something they can hand to customers during presales.
ci-bot: pipeline private-deploy #402 queued -> succeeded :white_check_mark:
Sana (partnerships): Can someone volunteer to create the SI playbook draft? I can own the co-branding bits.
Eli (eng-platform): I'll draft the trimmed runbook and include validation tests. ETA Thu.
Marta (solutions): I'll add the troubleshooting matrix and a sample Nginx proxy conf.
Pri (sales): Once draft is ready, I'll prep a one-pager and pricing call-outs.
Sana (partnerships): Great. Also flagging that the marketplace launch for LangChain bundle needs the SI playbook attached as "deployment notes".
Eli (eng-platform): noted. I'll include links to the install artifacts and a small demo VM image for quick POC.
Marta (solutions): Quick example error fix: if agent fails to register, check clock skew and KMS key policy. Add command: `journalctl -u redwood-agent -f`
Pri (sales): I'll sync with channel partner team about training sessions for SI consultants.
Sana (partnerships): Action items: Eli -> SI runbook draft (Thu), Marta -> troubleshooting + proxy conf (Thu), Pri -> one-pager (Mon). Pre-brief scheduled Fri 9am PT with SigmaSI.
ci-bot: docs-bot: published playbook-draft to docs staging :pencil2:
Eli (eng-platform): Draft uploaded: https://docs.redwood.internal/si-playbooks/langchain-sigma (comments open).
Sana (partnerships): Thanks team, will send pre-brief calendar once docs comments settle.
